err_busy: The assistant and agents stayed busy, so it didn’t update. Try again later
reason_went_back: Went back to the old version
reason_no_start_one: The new version failed to start {count} time
reason_no_start_other: The new version failed to start {count} times
reason_marker_unsaved: Couldn’t save the update’s start count, so a crash loop couldn’t be caught
rolled_back: Updating to {to} didn’t work, so the hub went back to {from}: {reason}
push_failed_body: {why}. This version won’t be installed automatically again.
reason_machines_missing: These machines didn’t reconnect within 2 minutes: {machines}
push_updated_body: Installed automatically while the assistant and agents were idle. personad on your computers will switch to this version too.
not_release_docker: This hub can’t update itself: a hub in Docker updates with a new image (docker compose pull && docker compose up -d)
not_release_no_source: This hub can’t update itself: it doesn’t know where to find new versions
not_release_bad_source: This hub can’t update itself: hub.json’s update.url can’t be used ({error})
not_release_dev: This hub can’t update itself: development build ({version})
why_docker: A hub in Docker updates with a new image (docker compose pull && docker compose up -d)
why_no_source: It doesn’t know where to find new versions
err_no_binary: This version has no binary for {platform}
err_no_image: Don’t know which image this hub is: compose didn’t pass PERSONA_IMAGE into the container
image_private: Couldn’t check for a new image: {error}. Set PERSONA_REGISTRY_TOKEN in .env (a token that can read this image), or make the image public
image_failed: Couldn’t check for a new image: {error}
err_no_start: The new version did not start; the old one keeps running: {error}
reason_no_takeover: The new version could not take over: {error}
reason_not_confirmed: The new version was not confirmed within 3 minutes
err_program_unreplaced: Version {version} has no {program} for {platform}, and {service} runs it: installing it would leave {program} on the old version. Wait for a release that includes it
